evidence.input: 100000-element integer reduction: total starts at 0 and consumes range 0..<100000
evidence.setup: one jet build --optimize=full per arm into a fresh directory; each warmup/trial runs that executable as a fresh process in a fresh empty directory

pair_measurement.sampling: balanced_seeded_fisher_yates; one build per arm, fresh process and fresh empty directory per sample

pairs.workload: 100000-element integer reduction with identical final stdout
pairs.verdict_reason: Historical: measured on the retired interpreter tier, where runs across four unrelated clean binaries straddled 1.00. The pair needs a new measurement on the native tier.

pairs.workload: 65536-pixel RGBA struct row (a 256x256 image) cleared to one pixel over 2048 frames with an identical checksum
pairs.verdict_reason: Strict win on the native tier: median ratio 0.169, paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound 0.174 (100 trials, 10 warmups).

pairs.workload: 65536-byte U8 row (a 128x128 RGBA image) tiled with a 4-byte pixel over 2048 frames with an identical checksum
pairs.verdict_reason: Strict win on the native tier: median ratio 0.056, paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound 0.058 (100 trials, 10 warmups).

pairs.workload: 64 MiB over loopback TCP, written in 4 KiB blocks by a writer task, read in 4096-byte reads until end of stream
pairs.verdict_reason: Strict win on the native tier: median ratio 0.849, paired-bootstrap 95% upper bound 0.947 (100 trials, 10 warmups); allocations per read and peak live heap win; peak RSS ratio 0.9995 with its 95% interval 0.9984..1.0008 across 1, inconclusive at page resolution.

signal.definition: GET readiness path returns a numeric value greater than the value observed before the edit

phases.cold: first measured edit after a fresh process reaches readiness
phases.warm: measured edit after two unmeasured edits in the same fresh process

command: printf '%s\n' main.c | entr -nr sh -c 'gcc -O2 main.c -o main-c && exec ./main-c {port}'

fairness: median cold and warm reload samples

oracle.output: cases {case_count} valid {valid} boundary {boundary} oob {oob} use_after_free {use_after_free} wrong_output {wrong_output} bytes {byte_count} checksum {u32_sum} semantic {semantic}

compile_throughput.basis: Owner direction 2026-10-02 on #4308/#4310: ~300k lines in under 2 s, nonincremental, all cores by default, explicit single-threaded option; D-EXEC1=A (jet build defaults to O1)
compile_throughput.artifact_discovery: from the compiler receipt (efficiency note, section 6), never by file mtime

programs.shape: shaped after L5 (25.6 lines per function, 53 bytes per line, 4.7% comptime items): 22.6 lines per function, 45 bytes per line, 4.8% comptime items; structs/enums with payloads/traits through trait values/generic functions/closures/value and variant matches/maps/strings/interpolation; one source file of 308 sections until both compilers build one multi-file package (Tools/perf/scaling/corpora/Source/Mixed.jet)

programs.source: the compiler corpus: the compiler's package graph and Core (Compiler/package.jet; `jet build Compiler`); its lines are their physical lines

compile_throughput.cache_lane: clean_full_build: no user checked/object/final-artifact reuse, empty program store, no daemon; shipped prebuilt runtime and Core interface record allowed; one unmeasured warmup for page cache

gates.determinism: default and single arms produce byte-identical artifacts and diagnostics
gates.phase_budgets: Tools/perf/budget/budget.json rows at its target column: per-phase budgets (ns per code line, a lines/s rate each) composing to 30M lines/s end to end; a phase over budget names the cards that own its root

compile_throughput.output_validation: the built artifact runs; stdout byte-exact against the golden; failure, mismatch, or a missing sample fails closed
compile_throughput.comparator: absolute thresholds; strict (equality fails); no averaging across programs, arms, or lanes

lanes.full: both programs, both arms, 5 samples: at every speed-card close and at milestones
lanes.quick: bench30k (same generator, --code-lines 30000) phases with JET_TRACE_FILE, 3 samples: every compiler-touching change, regression budget 15% per phase (Tools/perf/baseline.json budgets) against Tools/perf/throughput/quick-baseline.json

implementation_pairs.scope: existing native compiler ABI marshalling; canonical Source shape semantics and image identity/root checks unchanged
implementation_pairs.program_driver: same trusted hello project compiled by both immutable compiler artifacts
implementation_pairs.sampling: interleaved matched trials, same source hash, machine, environment and compiler build profile; written pre-flight and main-agent admission required
implementation_pairs.output_validation: complete canonical AOT compile receipts, zero reports, actual input snapshot bytes and per-trial invocation roots/hashes matched, byte-identical emitted artifacts; actual codec-projected Source TaskRoots parity and negative identity checks
implementation_pairs.comparator: each optimized/plain median strictly below 1; equality, missing evidence, nonzero process exit or mismatched output is failure

build_system.basis: Owner direction 2026-10-28: Jet's build and package system must be lightning fast and substantially faster than Nix, as well as more powerful and easier to use, audit and reason about. Nix is a required peer.

project.shape: the mid-size build-time program (Tools/perf/build-time/midsize.mjs, 90 units) in 9 unit files plus the entry; Jet: a package whose @build.jet `build: fn` registers one executable; Nix: a flake whose stdenv.mkDerivation runs make over the same program in C (gcc -O1, parallel), nixpkgs pinned to the repository's flake.lock

peers.builds: jet build in the package root; JET_STORE_DIR under the work dir
the system daemon store with substitution off for local cells; a private local store and a file:// binary cache for cold_cache

cells.meaning: evaluate the build configuration without building
cells.prepare: nothing; the previous round left the project built
nothing; the previous build is current
append one new unused function to the peer's edit file

cells.meaning: build a checkout with no local build state while a populated cache or substituter holds the current build
cells.prepare: jet: remove the package's .jet directory and keep JET_STORE_DIR; nix: copy the current output to the file:// cache and delete it from the private store

cells.meaning: hermetic from-scratch build of the project with its toolchain present
cells.prepare: jet: remove the package's .jet directory and empty JET_STORE_DIR; nix: --rebuild runs the derivation again in its sandbox

fairness: one program, byte-identical output, validated after every timed build
fresh process per sample; peers interleaved, order alternating per round
Nix keeps its evaluation cache and its own toolchain closure; Jet keeps its shipped runtime and Core
Nix local cells run without substituter queries, so unreachable caches cost Nix nothing
build_system.comparator: ratio = jet median / nix median; eval, noop and incremental need ratio <= 0.25, cold_cache and scratch need ratio < 1.00; a failed command, wrong output or missing sample fails closed

standings.rail: matrix.json rails.standings names the peers and the ceiling; every comparison entry gets a row for each of them on every metric

programs.bun: node/main.mjs, run by bun in place of node
programs.vite: js/ (the entry's web program), bundled by `vite build --ssr runner.mjs` into dist/ and run by node
programs.asm: Tools/perf/asm-parity/<reference>/ref.S of the cells.json reference naming one of the entry's cells, built by Tools/perf/asm-parity/ref-build.mjs

metrics.startup: exec to first output, wall time; a service is timed from exec to ready
metrics.wall: wall time of the whole run; a service is judged by its p50 request latency
metrics.cycles: user-mode CPU cycles of the process tree, perf stat -e cycles:u, median of the run count
metrics.peak_rss: peak resident memory of the process tree
metrics.size: deployed artifact bytes, by the size basis below

size_basis.binary: Jet, Rust, C, Zig, Go and asm on non-web entries: bytes of the built executable
size_basis.web artifact: Jet and Rust on web entries: bytes of the emitted .js, .mjs and .wasm artifacts
size_basis.bundle: Vite: bytes of the bundle vite build writes to dist/
size_basis.script+runtime: Python, Node and Bun: bytes of the program's script files plus the interpreter executable and every shared library it loads outside glibc (libc, libm, libpthread, libdl, librt, ld-linux)

standings.judgement: ratio = jet / peer per metric; the peer floor passes below 1.00, the asm ceiling is met at or below 1.00 and its gap is ratio - 1.00
standings.missing_program: uncovered: the row stays, its reason names the missing program
standings.missing_toolchain: unavailable: the row stays, its reason names the failed version command
standings.failed_run: failed (build or run error) or mismatched (stdout differs from expected.out): the row stays with the reason

not_applicable.reason: Vite bundles web front ends; an entry without a web front end has nothing for it to build
